items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: Bob Sheppard lives in Los Angeles and I said I just need two short solos so I did that high tech, with e-mail.

ctx.x: Were you able to record that as an ensemble?
I did record most of it as an ensemble. There were a couple of guys that weren’t — Bob Sheppard lives in Los Angeles and I said I just need two short solos so I did that high tech, with e-mail.
Did you actually do it — he didn’t come?
